final_message:
I implemented `diffLines`, `renderDiff`, and `diffStats` in `src/diff.ts`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

`diffLines` builds an LCS length table over the suffixes of both lists, then walks them from the front. When the lines differ, it deletes the next line of `a` if that keeps the common-subsequence length unchanged. Otherwise it inserts the next line of `b`. This is the tie-break rule from the README. Leftover lines are appended as deletes or inserts once one list runs out.

I didn't run `tsc`, since the test runner executes the TypeScript directly and the README examples check out by hand. Nothing else changed in the repo.
